From: Ellen Frost <ellenfrost@ironcladbuildersllc.example>
To: Ellen Frost <ellenfrost@northgatelogisticsinc.example>
Date: June 6, 2025, 9:18 AM
Subject: Change order CO-019 - Westfield Data Hall Fit-Out

Hi Ellen,

Pricing for change order CO-019 on Westfield Data Hall Fit-Out (owner: Northgate Logistics Inc.) is below.
Reason: Value engineering
Scope: The parties agreed to the following value-engineering changes. Work covers upgrade light fixtures to LED and waterproofing membrane.

Items:
- Upgrade light fixtures to LED: 69 EA @ $180.25 = $12,437.25
- Waterproofing membrane: 872 SF @ $4.02 = $3,505.44

Subtotal: $15,942.69
Markup (10%): $1,594.27
Total change: $17,536.96

Status: Pending - need your sign-off to proceed.

Thanks,
Ellen Frost
Project Manager, Ironclad Builders LLC
